claims.statement: Francesco Melzi wrote from Amboise on 1 June 1519 to Giuliano da Vinci and his brothers in Florence, announcing Leonardo's death and the bequest to the brothers; the letter ends 'Datemene risposta per i Gondi'. Printed by Uzielli and in Richter.
